extraction_notes: The supplied three-page datasheet is for the B5817WS through B5819WS family; the plotted page-2 characteristics are labelled B5819WS.

Forward, reverse, and capacitance curve points were manually digitized from the plotted grid without interpolation; reverse-current values were converted from the printed mA axis to A and capacitance values from pF to F.

The p. 1 table gives B5819WS maximum forward voltage values of 0.6 V at IF=1 A and 0.9 V at IF=3 A, maximum reverse leakage of 1 mA at VR=40 V and Ta=25 degC, and maximum diode capacitance of 110 pF at VR=4 V and f=1 MHz.
The reverse breakdown voltage minimum for B5819WS is 40 V at IR=10 mA; the paired breakdown-current field records that published test current.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification. The power derating plot was not included because it is a thermal rating curve rather than a diode electrical characteristic.
